subject: dance
topicName: Emancipation of Expressionism — Kenrick H2O Sandy

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: 'Emancipation of Expressionism' was choreographed by Kenrick H2O Sandy for Boy Blue Entertainment and premiered in 2017

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Boy Blue Entertainment is a hip-hop dance company founded by Kenrick H2O Sandy and Michael Asante

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The choreographic intention is to demonstrate the power of expression through hip-hop dance and show how movement can communicate freedom

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The stimulus was the concept of emancipation — liberation through expressive movement — and the role of hip-hop as an art form for self-expression

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: What is the choreographic intention of 'Emancipation of Expressionism'? | Q: Name three hip-hop styles featured in the work. | Q: How does the structure of the work support its intention?

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: To demonstrate the power of expression through hip-hop dance, showing how movement can communicate freedom and serve as a form of artistic liberation. | Popping, locking and krumping — though breaking and house are also featured in the movement vocabulary. | The structure builds from a single dancer to the full ensemble, symbolising how expression spreads from the individual to the collective — one voice becoming many.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always name Kenrick H2O Sandy and Boy Blue Entertainment — precise identification is essential Use specific hip-hop terminology: popping, locking, krumping, breaking — not just 'street dance' Link the building structure (solo to group) to the intention of expression spreading and growing Discuss dynamics — the contrast between explosive energy and controlled stillness is a key feature Include design elements: the streetwear costume, bold lighting and powerful aural setting all reinforce the intention
